summary: Hold @antv/x6 3.1.8 for the legacy graph requirement: MIT, no known advisories and an active repository, but the legacy browser baseline is unrecorded, npm provenance is absent, and dependency-tree licensing and install scripts were not measured.
reasoning: 3.1.8 is MIT, has no deprecated flag, and the dossier records no advisories, so the 'no unfixed high or critical advisories' constraint is not triggered at this version.

Release recency meets the 12-month maintenance constraint: version 3.1.8 is dated 2026-08-11, the registry last publish is 2026-09-21, and the repository was pushed 2026-10-23 with 6,751 stars and 18 npm maintainers.
No npm attestation was found, so provenance is unavailable; the requirement's fallback is to pin the exact version and record the gap, which this review does at 3.1.8.
Publish-pipeline evidence was not collected, so this review cannot confirm CI/OIDC publishing, and the absence of provenance alone does not prove token-based publishing.

The requirement's first constraint is to record the legacy browser and runtime baseline before judging compatibility; that baseline is not in the dossier, and the package declares engines node >=20.0.0, so compatibility with the existing legacy runtime is unresolved.

The requirement asks whether the suite still preserves editing, selection, transform, history and export behaviour, but the dossier contains no behaviour, plugin-compatibility or upgrade-path evidence for the sibling @antv/x6-plugin-* packages, so that constraint cannot be assessed from this dossier.
Explicit version pinning matters here because 427 versions exist and the reviewed version is a specific 3.x release; drift away from 3.1.8 would invalidate this verdict.
D3 was named as an alternative, but no D3 facts were collected in this dossier, so this review does not recommend a replacement and does not compare the two.

Score 71 (hold band): security 26/30 for a clean advisory record, release integrity 13/25 for the provenance and pipeline gaps, maintenance 17/20, fit 9/15 for the unresolved baseline, and footprint 6/10 for 4 runtime dependencies against an 8.2 MB unpacked size with install size unmeasured.
caveats: The legacy browser and runtime baseline must be recorded before any upgrade; the package declares node >=20.0.0 and only CJS/ESM dual output is recorded, so confirm build and runtime compatibility first.
Without npm provenance, pin exactly 3.1.8 and document the waiver, per the requirement's provenance constraint; do not float on a caret range.

Only the four direct runtime dependencies (dom-align, lodash-es, mousetrap, utility-types) are recorded; licence compliance and install scripts across the full dependency tree were not measured, so the permissive-tree and no-install-script constraints remain unverified.
Install size was not measured and the unpacked size is 8,363 KB, so the browser bundle cost for the legacy application is unknown.
The v2 to v3 upgrade path and plugin compatibility are not evidenced; verify selection, transform, history, clipboard, snapline, minimap, stencil and export behaviour on 3.1.8 before committing.
156 open issues and an 18-maintainer roster reduce bus-factor risk but do not guarantee consistent release review.
96,653 weekly downloads is a popularity proxy that includes CI and transitive installs, not a measure of fitness for this application.
This package is reviewed independently of its sibling @antv/x6-plugin-* packages in the same batch; no verdict is implied for them.
